reviews.title: thin, thin, thin!  Love this! great texture, can write over it without ripping papers.
reviews.comment:
This mouse pad is a bit bigger than I wanted, but I made it work for me.  I wanted the thinnest possible because some how the ones with edges hurt my wrist.  Some it's the stitching that bothers me, and others the tops tend to roll up from my rubbing on it.
I love the texture of this pad, my mouse works great on it, and I can write on papers over it too.
It has a sticky back to it, but I only removed a small corner of the plastic sticky cover to "stick" it down to part of my desk.  My adding machine is holding down the entire other side of it.
Great quality.  Good value for the price.
reviews.author: Mariel

reviews.title: A Gamer's Delight
reviews.comment:
As an avid gamer, finding the right mousepad is crucial for achieving peak performance. The Glorious Gaming Elements Mousepad has proven to be the perfect companion for my Finalmouse or ultralight mice. With its XL size and glass-infused flexible cloth design, this gaming mouse pad truly delivers on its promise of speed gaming.
The first thing that caught my attention was the size of this mousepad. Its generous dimensions of 15"x17" provide ample space for smooth and unrestricted mouse movements, allowing me to glide effortlessly during intense gaming sessions. The XL size ensures that my mouse never falls off the pad, maintaining consistent precision and accuracy.
The glass-infused flexible cloth surface is a game-changer. It strikes the perfect balance between speed and control, giving me the best of both worlds. The mouse glides effortlessly across the pad, providing lightning-fast response times, while still offering enough resistance for precise targeting in critical moments.
Using this mousepad with my Finalmouse or ultralight mice has been a revelation. It's evident that this pad is optimized for lightweight and high-performance gaming mice. I've noticed a significant improvement in my gaming performance, with smoother flick shots and more accurate tracking.
Moreover, the surface feels incredibly nice and smooth to the touch. It's a pleasure to use, even during extended gaming sessions. The cloth material is comfortable for both my wrist and my mouse, reducing fatigue and allowing me to focus solely on my gameplay.
In conclusion, the Glorious Gaming Elements Mousepad is a true gamer's delight. Its XL size, glass-infused flexible cloth surface, and compatibility with Finalmouse or ultralight mice make it an excellent choice for any serious gamer seeking to elevate their gaming experience. Whether you're into fast-paced shooters or precise strategy games, this mousepad will undoubtedly enhance your performance and bring your gaming to the next level.
